# discord_entitlement (Data Source)

Lists entitlements (granted SKUs) for a Discord application, optionally filtered by user or SKU.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_entitlement" "user" {
  application_id = "123456789012345678"
  user_id        = "222222222222222222"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the application.

### Optional

- `sku_id` (String) Filter to entitlements for this SKU ID.
- `user_id` (String) Filter to entitlements for this user ID.

### Read-Only

- `entitlements` (Attributes List) The matching entitlements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entitlements))

<a id="nestedatt--entitlements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entitlements`

Read-Only:

- `deleted` (Boolean) Whether the entitlement was deleted.
- `ends_at` (String) End of the entitlement validity.
- `guild_id` (String) Guild the entitlement is for.
- `id` (String) Entitlement snowflake ID.
- `sku_id` (String) SKU the entitlement grants.
- `starts_at` (String) Start of the entitlement validity.
- `type` (Number) Entitlement type.
- `user_id` (String) User the entitlement is for.
